name: Goodness
overview: Scripture reveals that God's goodness is a steadfast and powerful reality experienced by those who trust in Him. The Psalms emphasize that goodness and mercy accompany believers throughout their lives, providing assurance and strength in times of trouble. Believers are called to trust and 'taste and see' the Lord's goodness, which is stored up for those who fear and rely on Him. Furthermore, Romans assures us that all things work together for good to those who love God and are called according to His purpose, highlighting the purposeful and loving nature of God's goodness toward His people.
